dynamic-element.dynamic-content: Business Cockpit Subscription renewal for OEMs:

dynamic-element.name: Text50680698
dynamic-element.dynamic-content: ओईएम सदस्यता समाप्त होने से पहले के महीने में नवीनीकरण कर सकते हैं। नवीनीकरण से समाप्ति की तारीख से एक साल तक पहुँच बढ़ती है।

dynamic-element.name: RichText13464850
dynamic-element.dynamic-content: • Renew Subscription option is available to those OEMs whose subscription is getting expired within a month. The Pay now link is visible to the OEMs till they make the payment. Once the OEMs make the payment, the subscription will get renewed from the expiry date for next one year. If OEM didn’t renew their services, Business cockpit page will stop displaying statistics/data starting from the date of expiry of subscription.
